title: Base 7
description:
Given an integer num, return a string of its base 7 representation.
## Examples

### Example 1
```text
Input: num = 100
Output: "202"
```
### Example 2
```text
Input: num = -7
Output: "-10"
```

## Constraints

- -10^7 <= num <= 10^7
